finding: System.IntPtr zero converts to true in the PowerShell predicate used for MainWindowHandle, so a headless process was incorrectly treated as having a window. CloseMainWindow returning false was also ignored, causing an unnecessary 10-second wait before force termination.
change: Convert MainWindowHandle to Int64 before testing for zero; if any target process lacks a window or CloseMainWindow returns false, immediately select the existing force-stop path.

verification.fixture: A disposable copied Node executable named Win-Box.exe with a 60-second timer, installed in an isolated temporary directory.

limitations: The running process is a headless fixture, not the full Win-Box desktop app while playing video or hidden by boss-key.
Cancellation preserving the existing installation and migration of each user data domain still need acceptance.
V04 remains open until those desktop and data migration scenarios are verified.
